+"""Live visual controller for the frozen RoboCasa GR1 wine-to-cabinet episode."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = Path('/app/output')
+CAMERAS = ['egoview', 'robot0_agentview_left', 'robot0_eye_in_left_hand']
+BASE_T = np.array([2.65, -2.175, 0.970], dtype=float)
+
+
+def world_to_base(p):
+    p = np.asarray(p, dtype=float) - BASE_T
+    # R_base_to_world is +90 degrees about z, so R.T @ p.
+    return np.array([p[1], -p[0], p[2]], dtype=float)
+
+
+def current_state(robot):
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video='none')
+    return obs
+
+
+def pose_indices(layout, side):
+    start = layout.index(f'cmd_{side}_x')
+    return slice(start, start + 6)
+
+
+def hand_indices(layout, side):
+    start = layout.index(f'cmd_{side}_little')
+    return slice(start, start + 6)
+
+
+def eef_world(obs, side):
+    n = obs.meta['proprio']['now']
+    lay = obs.meta['proprio']['layout']
+    i = lay.index(f'eef_{side}_x')
+    return np.asarray(n[i:i+3], dtype=float)
+
+
+def get_commands(obs):
+    n = np.asarray(obs.meta['proprio']['now'], dtype=float)
+    lay = obs.meta['proprio']['layout']
+    return n[pose_indices(lay, 'right')].copy(), n[pose_indices(lay, 'left')].copy(), \
+        n[hand_indices(lay, 'right')].copy(), n[hand_indices(lay, 'left')].copy()
+
+
+def submit_poses(robot, obs, right_pose, left_pose, right_hand=None, left_hand=None,
+                 seconds=1.0, note=''):
+    """Move both grip-site targets smoothly for the requested number of seconds."""
+    r0, l0, rh0, lh0 = get_commands(obs)
+    rh = rh0 if right_hand is None else np.asarray(right_hand, dtype=float)
+    lh = lh0 if left_hand is None else np.asarray(left_hand, dtype=float)
+    steps = max(1, int(round(seconds / robot.spec()['control_dt'])))
+    rows = np.zeros((steps, 24), dtype=float)
+    for i, f in enumerate(np.linspace(1.0 / steps, 1.0, steps)):
+        rows[i, 0:6] = r0 + f * (np.asarray(right_pose) - r0)
+        rows[i, 6:12] = l0 + f * (np.asarray(left_pose) - l0)
+        rows[i, 12:18] = rh
+        rows[i, 18:24] = lh
+    res = robot.submit('ee_pose', rows, interpolate='hold', cameras=CAMERAS,
+                       video='mp4', include_depth=True, note=note)
+    return res
+
+
+def save_call(res, name):
+    res.save(str(OUT / name))
+    n = res.meta.get('proprio', {}).get('now', [])
+    print(json.dumps({
+        'saved': name,
+        'control_steps': res.meta.get('control_steps'),
+        'time_left_s': res.meta.get('time_left_s'),
+        'done': res.meta.get('done'),
+        'reason': res.meta.get('reason'),
+        'eef_left_world': n[78:81] if len(n) >= 81 else None,
+        'eef_right_world': n[81:84] if len(n) >= 84 else None,
+        'cmd_right': n[84:90] if len(n) >= 90 else None,
+        'cmd_left': n[90:96] if len(n) >= 96 else None,
+    }))
+
+
+def main():
+    robot = Robot()
+    obs = current_state(robot)
+    rpose, lpose, rh, lh = get_commands(obs)
+    # The bottle lies on the counter just left of the cabinet opening. Its calibrated
+    # egoview depth footprint puts its body center near world (2.43, -1.81, 1.01).
+    # Approach from above while keeping the fingers open.
+    pregrasp = world_to_base([2.43, -1.81, 1.19])

+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
